owner_objective: Continue the exact-head ten-coin Hixton 0.5.0 research using the 2026-09-29 deep-research findings: keep CAPITAL-V1-2X50PCT and the 250-USDC shared portfolio frozen; prioritize profit-first isolated alpha, profit velocity and capital efficiency while retaining drawdown/stress as hard gates. Test the fixed bounded hypothesis pack for ETH/BTC/SOL first and smaller evidence-led neighborhoods for LINK/XRP/AVAX/DOGE/BNB. Preserve ADA and DOT as mission-frozen promoted champions. A05 must compare winner and loser clusters so any filter is judged by avoided losses versus lost winners. A10 must diagnose slot opportunity cost for any isolated robust candidate and accept only positive baseline+stress marginal portfolio alpha. Never use validation/full/portfolio outcomes to rank new training candidates.

acceptance.exact_head: All research evidence is produced from one exact latest gpt/usdc-audit commit in a freshly created isolated venv.
acceptance.all_ten_fresh: Fresh exact-three-year baseline and stress evidence exists for each of the ten USDC coins with the current V6 profile.
acceptance.history_review: Prior Top-8 candidates, robust finalists, rejects and loss clusters are used to design the next bounded search rather than repeating the same grid blindly.
acceptance.selection_integrity: Candidate ranking uses training windows only. Validation/full windows can reject but cannot introduce or rank a new candidate.
acceptance.robust_coin_improvement: A coin counts as improved only if the challenger is non-regressive versus current in independent validation baseline/stress and full-three-year baseline/stress, improves at least one return measure, and stays within the drawdown gate.
acceptance.search_iteration: Coins with no robust finalist receive a bounded second-stage local search around their prior Top-8 parameter neighborhoods and measured losing-trade regimes. Search must remain finite and reproducible.
acceptance.no_forced_winner: If a coin still has no robust improvement, agents must report that fact and the concrete blocker; they may not weaken gates or reuse validation as training merely to satisfy the owner's target.
acceptance.portfolio_gate: Every robust per-coin finalist is tested one-at-a-time in the canonical saved-max-budget portfolio under baseline and stress costs. Combination testing occurs only after isolated holdout gates.
acceptance.no_auto_promotion: Research does not alter versions.py, Paper state, Live runtime, local WAITING_SIGNAL trial, credentials or active strategy.
acceptance.full_agents: A01-A08 produce specialist evidence; A10 synthesizes and routes unresolved coins; A09 independently QA-checks exact-head evidence; A11 rejects overfit/stale/mixed or automatically promoted results.

diagnostic_chain: pin latest engineering head and build isolated venv
load exact three-year closed 1h Binance-public history plus warmup
reproduce current V6 per-coin baseline and stress
run bounded profit-first hypothesis pack with training-only ranking
freeze Top-K per coin before independent validation
report profit velocity, profit per occupied hour, Sharpe/Sortino/Calmar and time-to-25/50 percent
compare winner clusters against loser clusters before recommending stricter filters
marginal canonical portfolio compatibility per robust coin
diagnose per-coin slot opportunity cost for rejected robust finalists
profile hash parity across isolated and portfolio runners
A10 synthesis and named repair/search routing

A01.objective: Audit prior coin-optimization history, methodology and candidate-space changes. Identify repeated/dead search regions and ensure the new round does not reuse validation for selection.

A02.objective: Run the fresh latest-head ten-coin three-year optimization in an isolated venv using the bounded profit-first hypothesis pack. Ranking remains training-only. Report current metrics, Top-8, profit velocity/capital efficiency, independent validation/full baseline+stress, robust finalists and marginal/combined portfolio evidence.

A03.objective: Verify engine/profile parity and deterministic reproduction between isolated single-coin runner and canonical portfolio runner. Reject any candidate whose parameter or policy hash drifts.

A04.objective: Keep optimization research isolated from shipped UI/Paper/Live. Verify no research candidate is silently presented as active or written to the local live trial.

A05.objective: Analyze both winning and losing trades for every unresolved coin using ATR regime, breakout strength and holding-time clusters. Quantify whether a proposed filter removes more loss than winner alpha. Use profit velocity/capital-efficiency diagnostics to propose only bounded next-stage hypotheses.

A06.objective: Enforce anti-overfit rules and test the bounded second-stage search. Never weaken holdout/full-window gates. Add regression tests for any new candidate-generation logic and make the search deterministic and finite.

A07.objective: Verify all ten current Binance USDC markets and execution filters remain valid for the backtest execution model; no private credentials or orders.

A08.objective: Evaluate opportunity cost after isolated improvements: marginally insert each robust coin into the canonical max-budget portfolio under baseline/stress, then test compatible combinations. Do not use portfolio outcome to discover candidates.

A09.objective: Independently QA exact-head research. Reject stale metrics, holdout-selected candidates, missing stress evidence, non-deterministic runs or claims that all ten improved when evidence does not show it.

A10.objective: Synthesize all ten coins with priority on net OOS USDC and profit velocity. For every robust isolated candidate rejected by the 250-USDC portfolio, identify slot/opportunity-cost effects and route a bounded timing hypothesis. Aggregate improvement may never hide an unresolved individual coin.

A11.objective: Govern the research loop. Require exact-commit A01-A10 evidence and prohibit gate weakening, holdout leakage, automatic canonical promotion or interference with the armed local 1x50 trial.

owner_context.local_trial: A separate locally authenticated 1x50-USDC trial may remain WAITING_SIGNAL; optimization must not require restart/update and must not use private credentials.
